title: The Gaze
tone: Faces in a gallery that look back at you, and finally one that turns away.

episodes.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring, c. 1665
episodes.scene: She turns over her shoulder, lips parted, as if you had just spoken.

episodes.title: Mona Lisa, c. 1503
episodes.scene: The gaze that follows you round the room.

episodes.title: Jeanne Hébuterne, 1919
episodes.scene: Modigliani paints her eyes as blank almonds: a gaze you cannot meet.

episodes.title: Madame Gautreau, c. 1883
episodes.scene: Sargent draws her in strict profile: she will not look at you.
